The team has embarked on a strategic scheduling adjustment designed to unlock more sustainable planning outcomes. Weekly planning previously happened on Monday, but recurring incident work made that slot unreliable and frequently fragmented the discussion. Moving the meeting to Tuesday should create a more stable window for prioritization while still leaving enough time to adjust the week's work. The team will review the change after three weeks and decide whether the new cadence is actually helping.
